purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: City-specific municipal urban-planning cadastre is documented, but reviewed public city layers contain no parcel geometry. The state public cadastral map was reported unavailable; the national geoportal redirects to login. No anonymous, safe, city parcel geometry route was verified.
registryAssessment: Kharkiv municipal cadastre exists, but this review verified no public parcel-vector coverage at the WUP point; the open city map exposes non-parcel municipal themes.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Kharkiv City Council Department of Urban Planning and Architecture describes the municipal urban-planning cadastre service and its role in receiving, registering and supplying non-restricted cadastral information.
Official city open map portal lists thematic municipal datasets; reviewed portal does not expose parcel geometry.
Regional State GeoCadastre page describes public cadastral-map services and says the public cadastral map is temporarily unavailable; service requires registration for relevant records.
